status_definition: The f80bca0 run executed completely and reproducibly; it failed three pre-registered conditions at unchanged thresholds. It is retained as formal negative evidence and must not be deleted, overwritten or reinterpreted.

not_status.reason: No identity error, unit error, numerical-implementation error, registration-contract error or supervision leakage was found. config_source.yaml is byte-identical to the committed config/task_state_v1/solver_registration.yaml; semantic/input fingerprints bind the run to calibration config and inputs; all 3884 jobs are accounted for; all stage worker_errors are empty; determinism is bitwise over 4/4 cases.
invalid_trigger_conditions_checked: physical unit conversions (fs->s, kHz->Hz, mm/s->m/s, um->m)
registration domain equals optimizer domain (physics_params imported from the calibration runner)
no parameter fitting performed during registration (parameter_fitting_executed=false)

full_recipe_coverage.question_2_threshold: limit == 0 => 2160 recipe cases (180 MAIN180 recipes x 4 switches x 3 waists)
full_recipe_coverage.question_3_observed: 48 cases executed (4 recipes x 4 switches x 3 waists); 2.22% of the formal scope
full_recipe_coverage.question_4_nature: incomplete scope, not a code defect and not a scientific negative result
full_recipe_coverage.question_10_rerun_justification: scope completion only (run --limit-recipes 0); not to obtain a positive result

parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_2_threshold: all 3744 sampled vectors accepted and finite; max_window_attempts <= 4; all 41154 descriptor checks error <= 0.01 via denominator max(|reference|, fixed scale)
parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_3_observed: 3/3744 vectors rejected with 'Window attempt registration budget exceeded'; 3/41154 descriptor checks failed; all three at waist 0.874 um with defocus switches P10/P11; all vectors strictly inside the declared box
parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_4_nature: scientific/engineering negative result, not a code defect. The solver converged inside its internal 16-retry budget (otherwise the message would be 'Finite scan failed window/update budget'); only the pre-registered 4-attempt acceptance budget was exceeded, which is exactly the behavior mandated by E03_REGISTRATION_AUDIT_20260908_ZH.md point 5
parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_7_P11_skeleton: 2 of the 3 failures are P11 at w0=0.874 um, so P11 numeric validity is NOT established at the tightest waist; P11 may still be used as an inductive skeleton but not as a validated ground-truth generator over the full declared domain
parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_8_code_change_scope: diagnostic only: record max_window_attempts_observed for rejected vectors so the domain/solver decision can distinguish 'needs 5 attempts' from 'needs 16 attempts'
parameter_domain_finite_and_converged.question_10_rerun_justification: domain/solver scope decision (restrict the 0.874 um defocus sub-domain or improve the solver initial bound and re-register). Explicitly NOT for the purpose of turning the gate positive

grid_refinement_converged.question_2_threshold: 960 descriptor checks (640->1280 bilinear-mapped to the canonical 160-pixel centers, plus 1280-mapped vs direct ROI) all with error <= 0.01
grid_refinement_converged.question_3_observed: 2/960 failed, both check=grid_finest and descriptor=ilr_z2: 0.01080425601888252 (grid_0_P00_w2.0) and 0.010887487062417019 (grid_0_P10_w2.0), i.e. 8.9% over threshold; all grid_to_direct_points checks pass and every other descriptor stays below 0.0083
grid_refinement_converged.question_4_nature: numerical discretization-convergence negative result, not a code defect
grid_refinement_converged.question_7_P11_skeleton: ilr_z2 is not grid-converged to 1% at w=2.0 um; any descriptor-level supervision built on ilr_z2 must carry this caveat
grid_refinement_converged.question_8_code_change_scope: diagnostic only: add a third grid level to determine whether ilr_z2 is converging. The 0.01 tolerance must not be loosened
grid_refinement_converged.question_10_rerun_justification: convergence determination for one descriptor, plus any rerun forced by the F1/F2 decisions. Not for the purpose of turning the gate positive

implausible_depth.note: Informational flag by explicit config design ('never silently dropped, never a gate'). Physics model extrapolates implausible depths in domain corners.

sensitivity_3w_vs_6w.note: Passes. 6w vs 8w tail difference is exactly zero in many cases because fluence beyond 6w is ~exp(-72) of peak; zero difference is not independent evidence of accuracy.

conditions: explicit disposition of the w0=0.874 um + defocus sub-domain (domain restriction documented, or solver initial-bound improvement followed by full re-registration)
P11_inductive_skeleton_decision.supporting_evidence: P11 passes 12/12 recipe-coverage cases at the nominal fixture, 3741/3744 domain vectors, all grid_to_direct_points checks, and bitwise determinism; the failures are localized to the tightest waist and to one descriptor at w=2.0 um.
